$comment: Flag Hoist on the Signal Deck (Thousand-Bough, Ines): six orders. A `flag` order is answered with one of the four flags (the bins, keys 1-4; the mast's flags are drawn by `symbol`); a `choice` order with one of its own choices (`right` marks the answer; `flag` is what goes up the mast, or null). Each wrong pick drops back with Ines's reason (`text`) and the course section (`section`, an anchor in 02's README) it paraphrases. For the Copilot app course: 02 §Context Syntax, §Slash Commands and §Attaching Files (the tip, "Less is often more"). `line` is Ines's voiced order.

items.text: Copilot needs the Book App’s source folder.

#.text: `#` brings issues and pull requests. A folder comes with `@`, like `@samples/book-app-web/src`.

/.text: `/` runs a command. To bring a folder, type `@`.

&.text: `&` points at another session, not a folder. Folders come with `@`.

items.text: Get a recap of your last day’s work.

@.text: `@` brings files. A recap is a slash command: `/chronicle standup`.

#.text: `#` brings an issue. For a recap, run `/chronicle standup`.

&.text: `&` points at a session. For your recap, run `/chronicle standup`.

items.text: Attach the bug report about the empty state.

@.text: `@` brings files or folders. A bug report is an issue, and issues come with `#`.

/.text: `/` runs a command. Attach an issue with `#`, like `#12`.

&.text: `&` points at another session. Issues come with `#`.

items.text: Use what Rook’s crew’s session found.

@.text: `@` is for files and folders. Another session comes with `&`, when the prompt box offers it.

#.text: `#` is for issues and pull requests. Other sessions use `&`.

/.text: `/` runs commands. Other sessions use `&`, when the prompt box offers it.

items.title: Pack light
items.text: Copilot’s fixing one empty-state message. What do you bring?

why.text: That’s the whole hold. Copilot only needs what this one fix needs. Bring the smallest amount of useful context.
An empty hold isn’t useful context. Give Copilot the one thing the fix is about.
Only one issue is about this message. The rest is cargo it doesn’t need. Less is often more.

items.title: A letter from ashore
items.text: A letter’s on your computer, not in the repository. Get it into the session.

why.text: `@` picks files and folders from your project. This letter isn’t in the repository, so drag it from your computer onto the session.

choices.text: Drag it from your computer onto the session in the sidebar

why.text: `#` brings issues and pull requests, not files.
`/context` shows what the session holds. It doesn’t add a file.
